subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fertile
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fertile"** means capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops. (उपजाऊ)

 
 
• **Example:** The fertile soil of the region allowed farmers to grow a variety of crops.
 
 
 
• **"Productive"** refers to having the quality or power to produce especially in abundance. (उत्पादक)
 
 
• **Example:** A productive employee contributes significantly to the success of a company.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that a synonym for **'fertile'** is **'productive'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Productive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Amusing** (मनोरंजक): Causing laughter and providing entertainment.

 
 
• **Example:** The comedian's amusing jokes had the audience in stitches.
 
 
 
• **Destructive** (विनाशकारी): Causing great and irreparable damage.
 
 
• **Example:** The destructive hurricane left a trail of devastation in its path.
 
 
 
• **Hectic** (अत्यंत व्यस्त): Full of incessant or frantic activity.
 
 
• **Example:** The week before the product launch was incredibly hectic for the entire team.
 
 

45:Td53,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
